components.note: One page per week; schedule lists journal submission Dec 17 as 20%.
Team of four; Insight presentation 20%, initial concept presentation 20%, final presentation 30% per schedule.

grading.scale: Component work is graded by letter (A+ excellence, A better than average, A- expected average, B+ some areas missing, B and below major deficiencies, F unsatisfactory) and averaged by weight.
grading.extraCredit: Extra credit for particularly interesting journal examples; amount not stated.

ARTD 230.finalExam: No written final named; final project presentation December 6 (PowerPoint plus 20-page group report), 30% of grade per schedule.
